label: Classified as having a major brain disorder - Insight46 Phase 1
meta_rows: Classified as having a major brain disorder - Insight46 Phase 1

Insight46 phase 1 major brain disorder were determined by a consensus panel including consultant neurologists and study clinicians who had reviewed the participants. Decisions were made based on self-reported diagnosis, radiological reads, and clinician opinion.
